prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, super glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; every part of her is dramatically oversized at once: a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size; below that waistline, enormous round hips flare out more than three times the width of the waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face; her head looks small on top of her massive body; not a plus-size model, an overwhelming maximalist hourglass; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, half-up half-down jet-black hair — wearing a skin-tight full-body wetsuit of matte graphite-black neoprene with turquoise stitched panel seams, long sleeves and long legs down to her ankles, the front zipper pulled down to her belly button with the two sides of the neoprene fully covering her bust and the exposed skin only a narrow V down her chest edged by the zipper teeth, the neoprene stretched over every curve, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, the V of her chest and her hands, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands and a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms. The suit clings like a second skin and shows real material behaviour: fine pores in the matte neoprene surface, small puckers at her elbows, knees and hips, stitched panel seams, a few water drops running down the suit. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme super glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy turquoise leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy turquoise lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips.

Background: a sunny green meadow full of wildflowers with a dirt path, a wooden fence and gate of normal height, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
